text_en: He watches videos and plays games every day.
One evening, his eyes hurt and he felt grumpy.
His mum said that he should take a break.
So Nick turned off the tablet.
He went to the park and rode his bike with his friends.
That night, Nick slept very well.
Now he plays on the tablet for a short time, then he plays outside!
